_about: What a correct model extraction looks like for every price request in the two DEV sets (Ponce, Chattahoochee). scripts/offline_check.py fixes the model's reply to these lines, so only code is graded: unit conversion, matched sets, the rule order and every decline. Standard-set quote lines not listed here are read from the prompt (SKU code or exact description, and the number before ft/lb/x/of). Written by hand from the prompts, 15 Oct 2026.
